description_en: Queries the information of all subfolders of a folder
description_zh: 调用ListFoldersForParent查询指定资源夹的子资源夹列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-folders-for-parent --parent-folder-id r-b10000 --query-keyword rdFolder --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFoldersForParent

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the parent folder.

If you leave this parameter empty, the information of the first-level subfolders of the Root folder is queried.
parameters.description_zh:
父资源夹ID。

当该参数置空时，查询的是Root资源夹下的下一级子资源夹。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.description_en:
The keyword used for the query, such as a folder name.

Fuzzy match is supported.

支持模糊查询。
